facts.text: A multi-panel character reference sheet with eight labeled sections: a large 'HERO' environmental shot above 'FRONT', 'SIDE PROFILE', and 'BACK' full-body views, and a bottom row of 'FACE', 'JACKET COLLAR', 'HANDS', and 'BOOTS' detail crops.
The central figure is an adult person with short hair shaved at the sides and gathered into a small top-knot, wearing a black high-collared jacket, black trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
In the 'HERO' panel, the person stands on a wet, reflective urban walkway or street at night, with dark railings on both sides, buildings, and out-of-focus lights in the rain.
The top panel is lit by cool blue-white light from the left and warm amber practical lights on the right; rain streaks are visible against the dark background.
The 'FRONT', 'SIDE PROFILE', and 'BACK' panels show the same all-black outfit against a plain dark gray studio backdrop under soft, low-key lighting.
The 'FACE' close-up shows a diagonal scar-like mark through one eyebrow and a direct gaze with a serious expression.
The detail crops show the jacket's high collar and shoulder strap, hands with visible skin texture and grime, and worn black leather combat boots.

card.summary: A cinematic multi-panel character reference sheet for an adult figure in all-black tactical clothing, shown in a rain-soaked night street hero shot plus front, side, back, and detail views.

card.environment: Composite reference sheet: a rain-soaked nighttime urban street or walkway at top, and a plain dark gray studio backdrop for the middle and bottom panels.
card.lighting: Top panel uses cinematic low-key night lighting with a cool blue-white key from the left, warm amber background practicals, and wet reflections; studio panels use soft directional low-key lighting with dark falloff.
card.framing: Composite layout: wide full-body environmental hero shot at top; full-body front, side profile, and back views in the middle row; close-up details of face, jacket collar, hands, and boots in the bottom row.
card.style: Photorealistic cinematic character concept and reference sheet, moody, low-key, high-contrast, with a wet-night atmosphere.
card.characterisation: Adult with shaved-side hair, a small top-knot, angular features, a scar-like eyebrow mark, and all-black tactical clothing.

limitations: This is a composite reference sheet; the panels are separate views rather than evidence of continuous motion.
Exact personal identity and real-world location are not stated in the image.
